statement_scope: For sets with all subset products distinct, the maximal size is bounded by pi(N)+pi(floor sqrt N)+o(sqrt(N)/log N), with a matching baseline lower bound. Products include the empty subset and are injective on the powerset.
scope_cautions: No assertion here that every secondary exact formula conjecture mentioned by the source is separately formalized.
verification_limit: Successful observed replay is recorded in verified-run/verification.json.
